name: grafeas-structured-validation-diagnostics
instr:
Grafeas v1 cannot expose structured, machine-readable validation diagnostics without parsing formatted errors.

The `validation` package at `github.com/grafeas/grafeas/go/v1/api/validation` exposes `Reason`, `PathSegment`, `ValidationIssue`, and `ValidationReport`. `PathSegment` has `Field` and `Index`; `ValidationIssue` has `Path`, `Reason`, and `Message` for ordered nested or indexed locations, stable reasons, and readable messages. Inspection, prefixing, and combination must preserve traversal and insertion order, retain every finding, and never mutate inputs. Empty reports mean success. Nonempty reports keep the established InvalidArgument presentation and every issue message.

Make every typed validator for attestation, build, deployment, discovery, image, package, and vulnerability report invalid values independently at exact paths. Distinguish absence, nil, emptiness, malformed values, failed alternatives, and conditional companion requirements wherever they affect validation. Shared nested validation, including version validation, must retain every owning field and repeated-element index. Discovery occurrences remain unconstrained; discovery notes validate their analysis kind.

`ValidateNoteReport` and `ValidateOccurrenceReport` from `github.com/grafeas/grafeas/go/v1/api/validators/grafeas` must combine generic required-field findings with typed findings under canonical oneof prefixes. `API.ValidateNote` and `API.ValidateOccurrence` from `github.com/grafeas/grafeas/go
